t.label: time
t.description: Duration (T for turns, s for seconds)

am.label: amount_max
am.description: Maximum strength of a stackable buff

p.label: probability
p.description: Probability of effect triggering (used for crit and Armored)

values.description: Enmity/Character Enmity [+ Jammed, AX / use nen for weapon-type modifier]
Stamina/Character Stamina [+ Strength, AX / use nst for weapon-type modifier]
Normal Enmity [+ all weapon grid Enmity]
Normal Stamina [+ all weapon grid Stamina]

n.label: number
n.description: Number of times the status takes effect

hide.description: Hide parts of the status (valid values: amount, wiki_comment, maybe others?)

1.label: item_name
1.description: Name of item (including characters, weapons, summons, and supplies)

nolink.description: Suppress the link to the item page

numleft.description: Move the quantity number to the left side

large.description: Use the large rectangular image (similar to icon=icon, size=110; append a number to set the width - large,110)

notitle.description: Suppress the label of the item

titlebelow.description: Show the label of the item below it

png.description: Try .png as the image extension (only for some images)

link.description: Set a custom link for the item

title.description: Set a custom label for the item

size.description: Set the image width (default 25, typically 110 for icon=icon)

element.description: Set an element (used as shorthand for certain supply items such as orbs)

weapon.description: Set a weapon (used as shorthand for certain supply items such as weapon stones)

arcarum.description: Set an associated Arcarum (used as shorthand for certain supply items such as ideans)

art.description: Select an art variant (A, B, C, D, etc)

uncap.description: Set an uncap level (adds _★ to the label)

prefix.description: Add a prefix to the label

suffix.description: Add a suffix to the label
